tools.name: aigc_create
tools.description: Image, video and music creation through explicitly configured providers. Read capabilities first. generate needs kind, a final host-written prompt and stable request_id. References use Core/Persona handles with explicit roles; put one edit-target/scene-layout first, identity sheets after it. parameters are provider-specific. Returns accepted job id, not goal completion or playback. status/read/inputs/list query original evidence, wait is cancellable without cancelling the job, cancel closes local work but remote computation may continue. reconcile takes only id and reads the accepted original provider task; it requires a recorded matching provider instance, never resubmits and preserves the prior failure. Unknown submissions are never retried automatically. No hidden planner, game connection, voice identity guarantee or automatic publishing.
tools.summary: 制作图片、视频或歌曲，并核对异步任务及原始素材

tools.name: aigc_help
tools.description: Read the bundled imagegen-derived creative guide: reference roles, prompt structure, preserving scene/camera/identity, output inspection, and image/video/music workflow. Does not call a model or read Persona memory.
tools.summary: 学习参考图分工、提示词组织和创作验收

tools.name: aigc_query
tools.description: Read configured creation capabilities, original jobs, prompts, references and artifacts without a tool barrier. read explicitly loads archived media. wait can be cancelled without cancelling generation. Job notices contain metadata only. Cannot generate, cancel, adopt, publish or play.
tools.summary: 查询能力、任务、原始输入和成品素材

events.description: Archived creation job terminal metadata and artifact ids; read retrieves media explicitly. No playback, adoption or goal completion is implied.

prompts.title: AIGC 创作能力
prompts.content:
You can create images, videos and music using aigc_create. First read capabilities; only explicitly configured providers are available. Read aigc_help for creative prompting and reference roles.

Use the read-only aigc_query for capabilities, status, list, inputs, read and cancellable wait. Completion notices contain artifact ids and metadata; read explicitly retrieves media. Creation and cancellation remain actions. Provider capabilities list supported parameter keys; do not assume an ignored parameter took effect.

Persona owns identity, known people, memory and artistic choices. If appearance_lookup is provided by Persona, select confirmed identity references there and pass their handles/revisions explicitly. The AIGC World does not inspect memory, other World files, ports or game state.

For an enhanced game photo, ask the game World for an ordinary screenshot plus historical scene/camera evidence, optionally a voxel proxy. Pass the chosen scene as reference 1 and identity references after it. Preserve the requested landmarks, action and camera; choose the composition and style yourself. Ordinary photography remains a game capability without a model. Original creations need no game.

Accepted is not completed. Use original job ids and status/read/wait or aigc.job events, then inspect the actual artifact before adoption. inputs retrieves raw prompts and original references. Preserve originals; distinguish observed facts from invented details. Creation does not publish or play anything. Use the relevant chat/performance World for that after choosing the finished result. Cancel waiting separately from cancelling a job; local cancellation does not prove remote work stopped.

changelog.0.1.0-rc.1:
- Prepare the first public beta for Cortico 0.2.4 / World API 6, with offline self-description and independent SDK/MCP exports.
- Keep image, video and music providers explicit and disabled by default; preserve source inputs, task identities, cancellation and terminal evidence.
- Include the validated 60-minute video timeout in the actual host settings schema.
- Retain failed or unknown generation attempts and reconcile original jobs without resubmission; support explicit revalidation of retained music.
- Include optional local provider sources and their original notices. Character assets, credentials, model weights and deployment configuration are not part of the package.
- Content fidelity, voice identity and concurrent GPU capacity require their own evaluation; successful generation is not content approval.
changelog.0.1.0-dev.20261021.2:
- Allow explicit revalidation of a retained audio file after automatic validation failure, preserving the old attempt and running every publication gate again without generation.
- Persist safe validation phases, ASR exit codes and bounded failure codes through the gateway and SDK instead of guessing which check failed.
changelog.0.1.0-dev.20261021.1:
- Match Cortico configuration round trips: use comma-separated result hosts and expose generation, polling and local workflow settings.
- Add explicit operator-authored ComfyUI video workflows with typed inputs, bounded error receipts and original task identity.
- Reconcile original image/video/gateway tasks without resubmission; pin provider identity and preserve earlier failure evidence.
- Retrieve retained YuE audio as an unapproved review candidate, preserving the original failed lyric/content result.
- Allow the optional YuE review gateway to read an existing credential environment variable; keep credentials out of package data.
- Isolate invalid provider settings so other capabilities remain queryable.
changelog.0.1.0-dev.20261020.3:
- Own artwork planning, optional YuE workers and EdenLive video inference; keep game capture in the public Minecraft core.
- Preserve migrated source licenses and explicitly configured application examples; mounting starts no model process.
changelog.0.1.0-dev.20261020.2:
- Add read-only aigc_query; retain existing query actions for source compatibility.
- Send metadata in terminal events, duplicate acknowledgements and job indexes; load media only on explicit reads.
- Preserve confirmed provider failure/cancellation, capture provider model/configuration and reject unsupported parameters.
- Remove provider import cycles through shared media/transport helpers and require explicit context budgets.
changelog.0.1.0-dev.20261020.1:
- Extract image generation from the Minecraft capture core into an independent creation World.
- Share explicit reference roles, archives, deduplication and cancellable jobs across image/video/music.
- Add native Wan2.7/FAL music and documented generic/local YuE gateway adapters.
- Provide Persona-owned appearance references and an adapted imagegen workflow guide.
- Preserve original capture archives and explicit legacy migration.
